title: Check if two strings are anagram of each other
problemStatement: Check whether two strings are anagrams of each other.
intuition: Anagrams are equal multisets of characters. Counting is O(n); sorting is O(n log n) and only worth it when memory is tight.

approaches.title: Brute: sort both
approaches.idea: Equal sorted strings means equal multisets.
approaches.code:
def is_anagram_sort(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
    return sorted(a) == sorted(b)
limitations: Slower than counting; acceptable if the alphabet is huge

approaches.title: Optimal: single counter array
approaches.idea: Increment for a, decrement for b, then check all zeros.
approaches.dryRun:
"listen" vs "silent"
every letter increments once and decrements once -> all zeros -> True
approaches.whyWorks: Equal multisets produce a net zero count for every character.

patternRecognition: Multiset equality -> counting array or Counter
followUps: Find all anagram substrings of a pattern (sliding window)
interviewInsight: Ask about the character set up front — it changes the space claim from O(1) to O(k).
